title: Derived associativity from section-normalized ordinary pullback comparisons
statement: For an arbitrary commutative coefficient ring A and schemes in a fixed universe, suppose an ordinary pullback composition family comp is given for all composable scheme morphisms, and its adjunction mate on direct images acts on sections by restriction along the canonical site pullback-composition isomorphism. Then the exact derived descent of comp is associative: for j:W→Z, h:Z→Y, k:Y→X, descending along j then expanding h followed by k equals transporting along associativity, expanding j followed by h then k, and expanding j followed by h. The equality holds on every object of the standard unbounded derived category. The operations and adjunctions are [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; the exact derived comparisons are those of [lem-trf-absolute-frobenius-site].

source.place: order 2579, pullback-composition coherence in the final naturality identity; Stacks 0D6D, exact termwise descent

proof.text: On direct images, evaluate the desired associativity equation on every module, site object and section. Replace every comparison by its assumed section formula. Site pullback associativity (MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_assoc) and the presheaf restriction composition law identify the two restrictions, including the transport between the parenthesized composite arrows.

The adjunction mate determines the ordinary comparison. Apply Adjunction.leftAdjointCompIso_assoc to the direct-image identity; transport the composite adjunction across the equality of the parenthesized morphisms. Taking inverse components gives ordinary pullback associativity.

Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso to the ordinary isomorphism equation. Its left and right whiskering identities and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_assoc give the derived equation. Equality induction identifies the descent of equality transport with equality transport of descended functors. Evaluate at an arbitrary derived object to obtain the stated pointwise equation. The category abbreviation only names the existing standard category instance.

proof_origin.place: E8, explicit mate/descent proof of the pullback-coherence step

theorem proEtaleNormalizedDerivedComp_coherence
    {X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (j : W ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ X)
    (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) :
    (proEtaleFrobeniusDerivedComp A j (h ≫ k) (comp j (h ≫ k))).hom.app M ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A j).map
          ((proEtaleFrobeniusDerivedComp A h k (comp h k)).hom.app M) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A)
        (Category.assoc j h k).symm)).hom.app M ≫
        (proEtaleFrobeniusDerivedComp A (j ≫ h) k (comp (j ≫ h) k)).hom.app M ≫
        (proEtaleFrobeniusDerivedComp A j h (comp j h)).hom.app
          ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A k).obj M)
